summary.zh: 開發次世代散熱材料，解決高功耗晶片的熱管理瓶頸。
summary.en: Develops next-generation thermal-management materials for high-power chips.

overview.zh: 台灣若美科技成立於2022年，是一家專注於熱管理的深度科技公司。其開發具熱輻射共振效應的散熱油墨、散熱塑膠等先進材料，提升PCB與電子產品散熱效能，以因應GPU/CPU功率密度攀升的散熱挑戰。
overview.en: Founded in 2022, Taiwan Ruomei is a deep-tech company focused on thermal management. It develops advanced materials such as heat-dissipating solder-resist ink and thermal plastics to improve PCB and electronics cooling as chip power density rises.

summary.zh: 運用基因定序與生物資訊技術，精準鑑定難治型感染的致病病原。
summary.en: Uses gene sequencing and bioinformatics to precisely identify pathogens in hard-to-treat infections.

overview.zh: 亞洲準譯成立於2020年，專注於以次世代基因定序與生物資訊技術，找出傳統臨床檢驗難以偵測的病原體。其為國內取得衛福部LDTS認證的病原基因定序檢測業者，可提升難治型重症感染的檢出率。
overview.en: Founded in 2020, Asia Pathogenomics applies next-generation sequencing and bioinformatics to detect pathogens that traditional clinical tests miss. It is a Taiwan provider of pathogen-sequencing testing with MOHW LDTS certification, improving detection in severe drug-resistant infections.

summary.zh: 提供漫畫等數位內容相關的資訊服務與線上平台營運。
summary.en: Provides manga and digital-content information services and online platform operations.

overview.zh: 日美資訊成立於2023年，登記營業項目包含資訊軟體服務與廣告服務，英文名為Manga Co., Ltd.，並招募前端與Python工程師，研判其經營漫畫等數位內容的線上平台與相關資訊服務。
overview.en: Founded in 2023, Manga Co., Ltd. is registered for information-software and advertising services and recruits front-end and Python engineers, indicating an online digital-content (manga) platform and related information services.

summary.zh: 主打低醣麵食的食品品牌，提供健康無負擔的減醣主食。
summary.en: A food brand specializing in low-carb noodles for healthier everyday eating.

overview.zh: 日日好食成立於2020年，是一家以「減醣」為訴求的食品品牌，主力產品為碳水含量約一般麵食一半的低醣麵。產品透過官網、蝦皮及量販通路販售，主打美味與健康兼顧的主食選擇。
overview.en: Founded in 2020, Goodfoodeveryday is a food brand centered on reduced-carbohydrate eating. Its flagship low-carb noodles contain about half the carbs of regular noodles, sold via its website, Shopee and retail channels as a tasty yet healthier staple.

summary.zh: 結合寵物營養與生技應用教育，提供營養與管理顧問服務。
summary.en: Combines pet nutrition with biotech-application education and consulting services.

overview.zh: 星耀生技教育為設於臺南的有限公司，聚焦生技應用教育，結合寵物營養、產品教育與經營管理輔導。其以生技為基礎提供寵物營養知識與管理顧問服務，屬綠色永續導向的生技教育新創。
overview.en: Based in Tainan, Xingyao Biotech Education focuses on biotech-application education, combining pet nutrition, product education and management consulting. It provides biotech-based pet-nutrition knowledge and advisory services as a sustainability-oriented biotech education startup.

summary.zh: 打造電動車充電與儲能電力管理平台，優化電網負載。
summary.en: Builds an EV-charging and energy-storage power-management platform to optimize grid load.

overview.zh: 岳鼎智慧能源（xMight）專注於電力管理與電動車充電整合服務。其xMight平台具備需量管理、動態充電功率控制與計費最佳化，協助商辦、社區與停車場在有限電力下解決充電需求，並為Tesla等客戶提供充電服務。
overview.en: xMight (Yueding Smart Energy) focuses on power management and EV-charging integration. Its xMight platform offers demand management, dynamic charging-power control and optimized billing, helping commercial buildings, residences and parking lots charge EVs under power constraints, serving clients such as Tesla.

summary.zh: 以生技創新切入智慧農業，提供農漁畜與飼品相關產品及顧問服務。
summary.en: Applies biotech innovation to smart agriculture, offering agri/aqua/feed products and consulting.

overview.zh: 禾益生物科技成立於2021年，總部位於臺中，專注於生技創新與智慧農業應用。其營業範圍涵蓋生技服務、動物飼品批發、農林漁牧顧問與研發服務，並曾參與臺灣智慧農漁週展出。
overview.en: Founded in 2021 and based in Taichung, Heryee Biotech focuses on biotech innovation and smart-agriculture applications. Its scope spans biotech services, animal-feed wholesale, agri/forestry/fishery/livestock consulting and R&D, and it has exhibited at Taiwan AgriWeek.
